title_zh: 约好补发缺少的一节帐篷杆

scenario.label_zh: 约好补发缺少的一节帐篷杆
scenario.goal_zh: 核对露营用品中的缺件，并确认店方将补发缺少的一节帐篷杆而无需退回睡垫

context_zh: 顾客在户外用品店展示露营套装内的部件和收据。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Penny
sentences.text: The sleeping pad is fine, but the tent won’t stand properly. I think one pole is missing a section.

sentences.speaker: Darius
sentences.text: Let’s compare it with the parts diagram. You should have four sections on this side, and I can see only three.

sentences.speaker: Penny
sentences.text: Do I need to return the whole camping set?

sentences.speaker: Darius
sentences.text: No. I can order the missing section for you. Keep the pad and the rest of the tent.

sentences.speaker: Penny
sentences.text: That’s better. Can the section come to this shop so we can check the fit?

sentences.speaker: Darius
sentences.text: Yes. I’ll order it for collection here and contact you when it arrives.

sentences.speaker: Penny
sentences.text: Thank you. I’ll keep the other parts together and wait for your call.
